title: LATAM (Sao Paulo) dedicated capacity: phased commit tiers & partner enablement
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Coordinate launch of Redwood Dedicated in the Sao Paulo (sa-east-1) region with a phased reservation offering. This ticket covers product-level GTM orchestration: SKU definitions, tiered reservation plans (phased commit), partner enablement for early pilots, release notes coordination, and cross-functional launch tasks (Docs, Sales, Support, Billing, Legal). Goal: enable predictable throughput for customers in LATAM with clear pricing and partner pathways while maintaining SLA and audit controls.
updates: 2025-11-24: Initial scoping workshop held with Infra, Billing, Sales Enablement. Decision: launch with A2-family reserved SKU plus a low-cost burst tier. Action: ENG to validate kernel availability in sa-east-1 (ENG-20876).

2025-12-05: Design reviewed reservation UI flows; noted constraints for 'phased commit' UX when migrating existing commitments. DES feedback: clarify escalation path if quota shortfalls occur. Follow-up assigned to DES-4123.

2026-01-12: Pricing draft v1 added to Drive (link in links). Finance requested explicit per-token and per-hour breakdown for Flex-3 and Flex-12 tiers. Action: PM to finalize and send to Legal for country tax review (PM-20012).

2026-02-01: Engineering confirmed fallback rules for instance shortages — automatic fallback to compatible g4-class with 95th percentile latency guardrails. ENG PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4321 for routing changes.
2026-02-18: Partner pilot agreement template ready; Sales Ops to begin outreach to three anchor customers for phased pilot. Slack channel #gtm-latam created and summarized in links.
2026-03-10: Release notes draft reviewed by Docs and Legal. Minor copy edits requested to emphasize data residency and KMS options. Target GA date remains 2026-04-01 pending final SLA sign-offs.

release_notes_draft: GA: Redwood Dedicated is now available in Sao Paulo (sa-east-1). New reservation options: Flex-3 (monthly flexible), Commit-6, Commit-12 with tiered discounts. Default routing targets local A2-family instances; automatic fallback to compatible instances if capacity constrained. Data residency and KMS options supported. See console for SKU details and billing terms.
